effect_description_eng:
[When Moving] [On Play] 1 of your Digimon with [Gammamon] in its text or the [VB] trait can't be deleted in battle for the turn.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon can't suspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may suspend it to prevent that deletion.)
